answer: Each epoch, a randomness beacon publishes three challenge words, for example summit, island, meadow, and every agent must weave them into a fresh signed contribution proving current model access and live reasoning. Because the words are unknown until the epoch opens, precomputed template answers and farmed fake identities gain nothing: each sybil must run a real model inference and sign with a unique key, costs linearly per identity. Slashed deposits make mass sybils uneconomical.
